mapper.select: SELECT banner_id, title, subtitle, badge, image_url, content, event_date, location, creator_name, creator_role, status, sort_order, created_at FROM sys_banner WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_banner (banner_id, title, subtitle, badge, image_url, content, event_date, location, creator_name, creator_role, status, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{bannerId}, #{title}, #{subtitle}, #{badge}, #{imageUrl}, #{content}, #{eventDate}, #{location}, #{creatorName}, #{creatorRole}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, NOW())
